metadata.dataset_name: Synthetic Broadband CRM & Rate-Card Ground Truth
metadata.disclaimer: CRITICAL NOTICE: This is a synthetic test fixture created exclusively for hackathon evaluation and QA gate testing. It is NOT official hackathon-provided data or real customer/carrier records.

documentation.purpose: Provides independent rate-card, CRM, and statutory ground-truth values to evaluate sales-call factual claims.
documentation.redaction_policy: All personal customer identifiers are maintained strictly as redaction placeholders ([CUSTOMER_NAME], [SERVICE_ADDRESS], [PHONE_NUMBER]). No fake PII is generated.

category_definitions.PASS: Expected values deliberately matching what the agent stated in the transcript.
category_definitions.FAIL: Deliberate synthetic rate-card discrepancies to test factual mismatch detection.
category_definitions.AMBIGUOUS: Target fields where transcript lacks sufficient explicit information or provides ambiguous wording.

ground_truth_records.rationale: Transcript-supported fact: The agent explicitly confirms Fibre to the Premises (FTTP) technology at the address in utterance utt_005.
